name: Impax Asset Management Group Plc
research_rationale: Q4 RNS confirms further net outflows and AUM at £20.0bn; FY26 H1 dividend and EPS reset plus weaker TTM cashflow versus dividends weaken the buy case despite unchanged management expectations.

weekly_updates.summary:
13 Oct Q4 RNS: AUM £20.0bn (−£3.3bn q/q); £2.4bn quarterly net outflows, concentrated in listed equities.  
Oct news flagged an outflow-led fair-value cut to £1.61; no new statutory results in this refresh batch.  
FY26 H1 filing picture (halved interim dividend, lower adjusted EPS) unchanged; management FY expectations “unchanged” per Q4 update.
